2220: Food: people and soldiers eat it daily. Run out and people starve and favor drops. Farms, villages and favor raise it. Above the storage cap (+650 per farm) it rots, so sell it in the Treasury tab. /day is the daily average including village tribute (most food comes from villages) — village shares arrive as tribute every three days
2221: Gold: spent on recruiting, building, gifts and mercenaries. Earned from markets, villages, trade and loot. /day is the Palace's own earnings only (after soldiers' pay) — village shares arrive as tribute every three days. If it runs out, pay is late and favor drops
2222: People: grows with housing levels. The base for recruiting; more people means more taxes. Below 60% of the cap there aren't enough hands and farms and markets slow; if soldiers exceed 60% of the people, favor drops daily
2223: Troops: Palace garrison + expeditions + village garrisons. One company = 100 men
2224: Favor: production multiplier for food and gold (60%–100%), population growth, and soldiers' starting morale. Below 30, desertions every night; below 20, riots (gold and people lost); at 0, the realm falls. At 80+, volunteers come every five days. Raised by victories, festivals, the chapel, the convent, sparring wins and blessings; lowered by hunger, defeats, unpaid wages and debt
